name: GNews
label: GNews
description: GNews official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: search, top_headlines. Docs: https://docs.gnews.io/. GNews.io terms. Auth is apikey query or X-Api-Key header (this node sends X-Api-Key). Article copyright remains with publishers. Snippets/links only. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One GNews request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: search | top_headlines. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: category
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `category` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: country
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `country` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `from` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: in
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `in` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lang` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `to` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: nullable
schema.description: Query-string parameter `nullable` for operations: search, top_headlines.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operations: search, top_headlines.

schema.label: truncate
schema.description: Query-string parameter `truncate` for operations: search, top_headlines.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: search | top_headlines. Example: 'search'.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
